in_sanskrit.name: शरणक्षणा
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who provides shelter, refuge or protection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who offers protection, safety, shelter, and relief. She is a goddess of refuge and salvation, a protector against fear and anxiety. She is also known as 'Sharanam', which means 'refuge' or 'shelter'.

in_hindi.name: शरणक्षणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: She is the embodiment of protection, safety, and well-being. She is the one who provides shelter, relief, and comfort. She is also known as 'Maa Sharada', who is the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_tamil.name: சரணக்ஷணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: She is the one who saves, protects, and shelters. She is the one who grants refuge, relief, and comfort. She is also known as 'Ammai', who is the goddess of motherly love and compassion.

in_telugu.name: శరణక్షణా
in_telugu.long_meaning: She is the goddess of refuge, shelter, and safety. She is the one who grants protection, relief, and comfort. She is also known as 'Saraswathi', who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Sharankshaana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharankshaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharankshaana is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit language meaning 'Goddess of Power'.
